## Episode Thesis

The episode covers the US midterm elections, where the Democrats won what is being called a 'blue tsunami' and took both the Senate and the House. DI's correspondent expects two years of political deadlock under President Trump, who has threatened to veto everything from Congress. That gridlock is a negative for the economy, but it also blocks new tax cuts and stimulus that could have pushed inflation and rates higher. Market reactions have been muted and uncertain so far. A closing AMF segment, which reads like an advertisement, argues that AI will be the dominant equity theme in the coming years and that global funds give broad exposure to it.
